reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the known role of AM-induced grain boundaries in promoting protective scale formation under oxidizing conditions (from P5, P10, P12, P13) with the concept of internal oxidation under oxygen-lean conditions (from P13, P29) to propose a novel, atmosphere-dependent degradation mechanism. No single passage or textbook proposes that the same grain-boundary network can switch from protective to detrimental based solely on gas chemistry, nor does any passage study this specific AM Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3 alloy under alternating oxidizing/reducing cycles.
